name: Prologue
lead: Prologue is the first chapter in Celeste , and starts automatically after creating a save. It introduces the four basic techs within the game: walking, jumping, climbing, and dashing . Three gameplay entities are introduced in this chapter: an Intro Crusher (a block which falls on its own), a collapsing bridge , and the (in)famous intro car . Madeline , Granny , and the Bird are also introduced in this chapter.
